provenance: Author self-review renewing evidence after the Shared nominal-kind revision. Read the complete required authored units, exact selected declarations/implementation/tests and policy; shared identical inputs were read once across packets. Inspected supporting example-state and embedding definitions and evidence helper code in retained source context. Compared statements, assumptions, examples and rejection boundaries with the prose; did not treat hashes, compilation or prior approvals as a substitute for this comparison.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.evidence.required_inputs against rust:mdbook-dada/src/evidence.rs:validate_bundle, rust:mdbook-dada/src/inventory.rs:Inventory::inputs, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:rejects_missing_or_substituted_required_inputs, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:renderer_lean_fixtures_are_required_freshness_inputs, test:mdbook-dada/tests/evidence_validation.rs:theme_assets_are_required_freshness_inputs. Inventory.inputs derives unit/selection dependencies and conservative tooling, theme, policy and source contexts; validate_bundle compares independently derived contents, hashes and paths and handles declared extras. Tests remove exact selections even when source context remains, substitute rehashed selections, alter Lean fixtures and change/add theme assets. These check input completeness/freshness, not semantic truth. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.units.closed_body, unit:meta.sources.configuration, unit:meta.sources.exact_selection.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent fresh reviewer.

Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
